nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 token held by the SupervisedTimelock contract.
Immutable address of the beneficiary entitled to released tokens.
Immutable timestamp at which the token release period starts.
Timestamp at which the whole benefit becomes withdrawable; mutable, reset by terminate().
Total amount of benefit vested by the schedule; mutably truncated by terminate().
Running amount already withdrawn by the beneficiary.
Flag indicating whether the contract has been terminated by the owner.
Constant 86400 used for day granularity of the vesting schedule.
Owner address stored in the inherited Ownable contract.
SupervisedTimelock constructor initializing token, beneficiary, release window and total benefit.
View function computing the vested amount at the current block.timestamp.
View function returning _totalBenefit - releasedBalance().
View function returning _withdrawedBalance.
Withdraws the newly released benefit to the beneficiary and updates _withdrawedBalance.
Owner-only function that truncates the benefit, marks termination and sends unreleased tokens to the owner.
Modifier requiring _isTerminated == false.
Getter returning the held IERC20 token.
Getter returning the beneficiary address.
Getter returning _totalBenefit.
Ownable modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender().
Private helper writing the new owner into _owner and emitting OwnershipTransferred.
Owner-only ownership transfer with zero-address check.
Owner-only function renouncing ownership by setting owner to address(0).
Context helper returning msg.sender.
SafeERC20 wrapper performing an optional-return ERC20 transfer via low level call.
External ERC20 balanceOf call used to check the contract token balance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks.
Block timestamp driving the vesting schedule and terminate() truncation.
External token transfer of the released amount to _beneficiary inside withdraw().
External token transfer of the unreleased remainder to owner() inside terminate().
Arithmetic update _withdrawedBalance += amount performed before the external transfer.
Arithmetic (_totalBenefit * passedDays) / totalDays producing the vested amount.
Constructor parameter for the ERC20 token address.
Constructor parameter for the beneficiary address.
Constructor parameter for the release start timestamp, floored to a day boundary.
Constructor parameter giving the length of the timelock in days.
Constructor parameter for the total benefit amount.
Local variable in withdraw() holding releasedBalance() - _withdrawedBalance.
Local variable in terminate() holding the unreleased token remainder for the owner.
Parameter of transferOwnership naming the new owner address.
Local variable in releasedBalance counting days elapsed since _releaseStartTime.
Local variable in releasedBalance holding the total vesting duration in days.
Local variable in _setOwner caching the previous owner.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is stored into the immutable state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is stored into _beneficiary.
Day-floored releaseStartTime_ is stored into _releaseStartTime.
releaseStartTime_ contributes to the computed _releaseEndTime.
daysOfTimelock_ is multiplied into _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ initializes _totalBenefit.
Constructor requires _releaseEndTime > block.timestamp, a timestamp dependency.
releasedBalance branches on block.timestamp, making vesting time dependent.
_releaseStartTime is read when computing elapsed days.
_releaseEndTime bounds the vesting computation.
_totalBenefit scales the released amount.
SECONDS_OF_A_DAY is the divisor for day conversion.
passedDays feeds the multiplication/division producing the vested amount.
totalDays is the divisor of the vesting arithmetic and can be zero if misconfigured.
_totalBenefit is the multiplicand of the vesting arithmetic.
unreleasedBalance subtracts releasedBalance() from the total.
_totalBenefit is the minuend in unreleasedBalance.
withdraw() gates on releasedBalance() > _withdrawedBalance.
_withdrawedBalance is compared and subtracted inside withdraw().
amount is derived from releasedBalance().
_withdrawedBalance is subtracted to compute amount.
Local amount is the value passed to the external token transfer.
_beneficiary is the recipient of the released token transfer.
amount is accumulated into _withdrawedBalance via unchecked-style addition.
_withdrawedBalance is the accumulator updated by the increment operation.
Result of the increment is written back into _withdrawedBalance before the transfer.
withdrawedBalance() getter exposes the _withdrawedBalance state.
terminate() uses block.timestamp to truncate _releaseEndTime, a timestamp dependency.
terminate() assigns the current releasedBalance() into _totalBenefit.
_totalBenefit is overwritten and used to compute the owner payout.
_releaseEndTime is reset to the current day boundary.
_isTerminated is set to true by terminate().
isNotTerminated modifier reads _isTerminated to gate execution.
withdraw() checks the contract token balance via balanceOf before transferring.
terminate() reads balanceOf(address(this)) to compute the owner payout.
Local amountToWithdraw is the value passed to the owner token transfer.
onlyOwner restricts terminate() to the owner.
onlyOwner restricts transferOwnership().
onlyOwner restricts renounceOwnership().
isNotTerminated modifier gates terminate() once the contract is terminated.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
onlyOwner compares owner() against _msgSender() (msg.sender).
Constructor forwards _msgSender() to _setOwner.
Constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender()).
transferOwnership() delegates the state write to _setOwner.
renounceOwnership() delegates to _setOwner(address(0)).
newOwner parameter flows into _setOwner as the new owner value.
oldOwner local caches the previous _owner inside _setOwner.
_setOwner writes the new address into the _owner state variable.
_setOwner reads the current _owner before overwriting it.
token() getter returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() getter returns the _beneficiary state variable.
totalBenefit() getter returns the _totalBenefit state variable.
withdraw() performs an external token transfer that may re-enter the contract.
terminate() performs an external token transfer to the owner that may re-enter.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer executes a raw external call on the token contract for the beneficiary payout.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer executes a raw external call on the token contract for the owner payout.
The _token address is the target of the beneficiary transfer call.
The _token address is the target of the owner transfer call.
